about_the_game:
Savior Syndrome is an isometric noir RPG detective game packed with psychological duels and a deep narrative, all set in a crumbling world of grimy biopunk.

You're Isaac Lang, a private eye from the slums of Jars – a city-state where scientists, clones, mutants and cults fight tooth and nail for their existence. Isaac's past is shattered, his mind a battlefield between guilt and the desire to help those around him. But can he really save everyone when he can't even save himself?                                                                                                    

Shape your protagonist's unique personality by leveling up Jungian archetypes (Persona, Shadow, Anima, and Animus) to manipulate your interlocutors, unravel their motives and break through their psychological defenses. Your reward will be genuinely unique ways the story can unfold.

Crack the mysteries behind strange disappearances, conduct interrogations, engage in psychological duels and decide who you'll become – a savior, a killer, or someone who can finally let go of the past.

Jars is a biopunk megacity where pharma-corps and religious orders battle for control over what's left of humanity. Cloning, gene editing and memory replacement are legal here. Here dwell those who voluntarily lease out their bodies. And conscience here goes for less than a hit of designer drugs.

Investigate, take bribes, pray, kill, save lives. Every action leaves its mark on your character's and on the city's other inhabitants' psyche. You can journey from cynical detective to messiah or ruthless executioner, but remember: your mental injuries are your main tool.                                                                                        

•      Dive into interactive investigation: interrogate suspects, collect evidence, analyze facts on your investigation board.

•      Change the course of the story: your decisions and how you roleplay your character affect how the world responds to you. Expect tough moral choices, characters packed with secrets and trauma, and shocking plot twists.

•      Immerse yourself in the grimy atmosphere of a dark biopunk city crawling with cultists, clones, mutants, and street gangs.

•      Get pulled into psychological duels where you'll need to find the key to each opponent's psyche.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of killing people and monsters. Scenes of alcohol and tobacco use.
